subject.title: fix: revalidate GitHub bridge agent tickets

question: Should the fail-closed WebVNC/Code GitHub agent-ticket behavior ship as written, including rejection of legacy or incomplete grant-bearing tickets after upgrade?
rationale: The code appears to fix the reported revocation gap, but it intentionally changes auth-provider failure behavior at a bridge boundary where maintainer security ownership should confirm the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Ship Fail-Closed After Security Review
options.body: Accept the short-lived legacy-ticket rejection as intended security behavior once maintainer/security review confirms the boundary.

options.title: Add Compatibility Guardrails First
options.body: Require focused compatibility tests or docs for GitHub-admin and legacy-ticket upgrade behavior before merging.

options.title: Hold For Alternate Boundary
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want WebVNC/Code agent tickets to preserve a compatibility fallback instead of matching egress fail-closed behavior.

recommendation.title: Ship Fail-Closed After Security Review
recommendation.body: Accept the short-lived legacy-ticket rejection as intended security behavior once maintainer/security review confirms the boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent bridge revocation history and is the clearest routing candidate for the auth-boundary decision.
